{{Top}}
A '''flight computer''' was a specialized [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system that monitored all systems aboard a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], including power, [[Engine/Legends|engine]] and flight. It also translated the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot's]] commands, allowing them to operate the starfighter effectively.
